## What this changes

Every §15.4 projection is derived state — dropping all of them must cost compute,
never information (SIG-STORE-004/005). This row makes that posture mechanical:
a documented rebuild command per projection, a seeded-spine drop-all/rebuild
equality test, and a per-layer privilege test that proves the rebuild posture is
also the layer-direction posture.

- `tests/db/test_projection_rebuild.py` (+4 tests, real PG18+PostGIS via
  testcontainers) — seeds a canonical spine exercising every projection family
  (conflicting quantity claims → resolution + contradiction; sharing edges;
  accountability role chains; camera + org records; research-queue inputs), runs
  all nine PG materializers, snapshots each derived table canonically, drops all
  derived rows child-first (`DELETE`, never `TRUNCATE … CASCADE`), re-runs the
  commands, and asserts **content equality** — minted ids/`clock_timestamp()`/
  `execution_id`s canonicalised, volatile foreign keys dereferenced to stable
  content identities before comparison. A guard test asserts the seed actually
  exercises every projection (a zero-row rebuild proves nothing); a
  volatile-declaration audit covers every column carrying a minted
  `gen_random_uuid()`/`now()` default so a new volatile field fails loud rather
  than silently passing; a no-drop re-run proves idempotence
  (`camera_site_execution` appends one row per fresh execution by design — the
  projection equality still holds).
- `tests/db/test_layer_direction.py` (+10 tests, real PG18) — the whole-schema
  write-privilege matrix per layer (`sig_ingest`, `sig_materialize`, the three
  read tiers, `sig_export`); `PUBLIC` holds no writes; no role reaches a layer
  below its own (direction probes under `SET ROLE` — `sig_ingest` is RLS
  read-blind to existing claims, the stronger-than-trigger boundary; it can
  still insert at its own layer); materialized surfaces are insert-only for
  their writer; L4's physical separation (`inference` schema) and its label
  columns; L2 entity tables carry identity only; `sig_ingest`'s lone
  `evidence_artifact` UPDATE is column-scoped to the disappearance-event
  columns; and the L4 drop/rebuild: `inference.derived_fact` emptied, then
  re-materialized content-equal from the unchanged spine.
- `db/README.md` — the documented rebuild command per §15.4 projection: the
  nine PG materializers in pipeline order under `--role sig_materialize`, plus
  the artifact projections (DuckDB analytics, export-bundle RDF/PROV-O, tiles,
  FTS5, edge lists, SQLite) whose "rebuild" is re-running the export; the
  pinned-row rule recorded (derived rows referenced by canonical human records
  are history, never dropped).
- `tests/db/test_org_cascade.py` → `test_org_cascade_materialize.py` — clears
  the carried duplicate-basename collision with
  `tests/resolution/test_org_cascade.py` (P37.46b `a0442c4a`) that stopped
  whole-tree `uv run pytest` at collection (recorded as carried in
  P37.53/P37.69a). CI's partition table is directory-scoped, so the rename is
  partition-neutral; it unblocks the local `make check` test step.
